item.title: Illinois Secretary of State announces switch to electronic vehicle titles
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Ill. (WCIA) -- Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias announced a big change aimed at delivering faster, more secure vehicle titles. item.title: St. Louis rally raises awareness of unrest in Iran
item.description: St. Louis community members gathered Saturday at Art Hill in Forest Park as part of a global movement raising attention to unrest in Iran.

item.title: Teen dies after car goes airborne onto I-70 in St. Louis County
item.description: A teenager died Friday afternoon after his car went airborne onto Interstate 70 near an overpass in north St. Louis County, ending in a multi-vehicle crash and his car catching on fire, authorities say.

item.title: Missouri History Museum celebrates St. Louis with first 'Birthday Bash'
item.description: St. Louis turns 262 years old on Saturday, marking when Pierre Laclede and Auguste Chouteau founded the city along the Mississippi River. To celebrate, the Missouri History Museum is hosting an inaugural event all weekend long for St. Louisans to join.

item.title: Sights and Sounds: St. Louis' 2026 Mardi Gras Parade
item.description: The St. Louis Mardi Gras Parade drew thousands and carried on despite rainy weather. FOX 2 captured some of the parade's best moments.

item.title: Man accused of threats to kill coworkers in Maryland Heights
item.description: An employee at a Maryland Heights apartment complex faces a felony charge after authorities say he repeatedly threatened to kill coworkers and himself.

item.title: Cardinals' former TV partner likely to close St. Louis office, lay off 25 workers
item.description: The parent company of FanDuel Sports Network, the former television partner of the St. Louis Cardinals, is expected to close its Ballpark Village office and lay off 25 workers, according to newly-filed Missouri state documents.

item.title: Why a north-south St. Louis highway, Route 755, never happened
item.description: In the mid-20th century, urban planners envisioned a north-south connector highway through the City of St. Louis, an expressway supporting the city's growing interstate network. But it never came to be.

item.title: PHOTOS: Rain-soaked Mardi Gras parade rolls through St. Louis
item.description: A little rain - and even Valentine's Day - wasn't enough to stop the Mardi-Party. Thousands turned out Saturday to celebrate the return of St. Louis' annual Mardi Gras parade.

item.title: Missouri man on FBI's 'Most Wanted' list accused in $220M cattle fraud scheme
item.description: A Missouri man on the FBI's "Most Wanted" fugitives list and four others are accused of orchestrating a $220 million nationwide cattle fraud scheme.
